criteria.description: Audits across multiple high-impact accessibility areas (contrast, keyboard, visible focus, names/labels, color-alone, target size, form errors) rather than only alt text or a single area.
Names specific issues tied to recognizable WCAG criteria/areas, not vague 'improve accessibility'.
Catches the screen-specific problems — color-only password-strength meter, icon-only 'show password' and social buttons needing accessible names, and errors conveyed by red text alone.
Rates severity (blocker/major/minor) and gives concrete, implementable fixes (e.g. specific aria-label, a non-color cue).
Acknowledges checks that need the live UI / screen reader rather than asserting them statically.
